cases.name: Rehabilitation intake
cases.headline: Repeatable posture and mobility records for every visit.
cases.need: Therapists need structured posture angles and neck-shoulder mobility without sending every client to an imaging lab.
cases.approach: X60 identifies anatomical landmarks, scores alignment and guides cervical lateral flexion and arm-elevation assessments in one workstation.
cases.result: A printable, shareable report with risk-level indicators that can be reviewed and corrected by the clinician.

media.alt: Nexbody-X60 in a clinical assessment setting

cases.name: Fitness body review
cases.headline: Composition and posture in a member-facing assessment.
cases.need: Operators want a premium assessment that members can understand — not a lab printout and not a weight-only conversation.
cases.approach: Eight-electrode analysis provides nearly 40 composition values with segmental breakdown, alongside posture scoring on the same system.
cases.result: Email, print and optional institution branding keep the report inside the facility workflow.

cases.name: Gait and pressure assessment
cases.headline: Plantar pressure and gait metrics on a dedicated platform.
cases.need: Gait, COP trajectory and stance timing belong on a pressure-sensor walkway — not on the X60 posture column.
cases.approach: OneScan’s piezoresistive matrix records pressure distribution, contact metrics and temporal parameters across five platform lengths.
cases.result: Reports for dynamic gait and static pressure that can be exported or connected through an open API.

cases.name: 3D foot morphology
cases.headline: Both feet scanned together for measurement and STL output.
cases.need: Custom insoles and C2M footwear need full-foot geometry, arch type and left/right comparison — separate from gait pressure maps.
cases.approach: F20 captures more than 30 full-foot parameters, hallux and heel valgus, and arch classification in one synchronous scan.
cases.result: STL models and comparable reports for retail, campus screening and orthotic workflows.
